name: What kind of chemicals or equipment do professionals use for smoke odor removal?

mainEntity.name: What kind of chemicals or equipment do professionals use for smoke odor removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals utilize a range of specialized tools and chemicals. Equipment often includes air scrubbers with HEPA and activated carbon filters, ozone generators, or hydroxyl generators to neutralize airborne smoke molecules. For surfaces, industrial-strength deodorizers, degreasers, and encapsulants (odor-blocking primers) are used. These products are formulated to break down and bind with smoke residues at a molecular level, effectively eliminating the odor rather than just masking it. Trained technicians ensure safe and effective application.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals use air scrubbers, ozone or hydroxyl generators, industrial-strength deodorizers, degreasers, and odor-blocking primers to neutralize smoke molecules and residues.
